title: Compass Point 1, Unit 204 | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Access To All WaterSound Amenities- Compass Point I, Unit 204 by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Compass Point I, Unit 204 by Royal Destinations Location: WaterSound Beach Address: 99 Compass Point Way South, Compass Point I, Unit 204 Details: Escape to Compass Point I, Unit 204: A stunning condo designed for every kind of getaway, from a family getaway or anniversary retreat to a Valentine’s stay or girls’ weekend. Wake each morning to the serene beauty of the Emerald Coast, and enjoy a short stroll to the sugar-white sands just beyond your door. Inside, you’ll find a gourmet kitchen with stainless-steel appliances and granite countertops, creating the perfect space for easy, elegant meals. Step out onto your spacious balcony, where comfortable seating and panoramic views of the Gulf, dunes, and WaterSound community make every sunrise and sunset unforgettable. Just 50 feet away, unwind by the inviting pool, complete with chaise lounges and umbrellas. A charming wooden bridge winds over the dunes, leading you straight to the pristine beaches of the Emerald Coast — the ultimate coastal escape. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 65 Yards -Parking Spaces: 1 in Garage (Additional Parking Adjacent to the Building) -Coffee Maker Available -Balcony Access from Living Area and Master Bedroom -Located in the WaterSound Community -Gulf Views -A short walk to the Dunesider Community Pool -*Available For Winter Monthly Rentals- Contact our team with any questions regarding pricing for monthly winter rentals. WaterSound Community Highlights: -Over 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach -(2) Community Pools (Dunesider Pool in Main Gate and Bridges Pool within the Bridges Gate) -Kayak Rentals -Parks, Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -Bike to Alys, Seacrest and Rosemary Beach -A short walk to the HUB *Please Note: Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included. *WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals from outside vendors. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6: 2 Bed / 2 Bath One Level: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 2: (2) Queen Beds with Semi-Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room / Laundry / Balcony with Gulf Views Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
